# Weeyar Wellness Supplements

> Weeyar Cosmetics (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd. is a B2B dietary supplement supply-chain partner supporting brands, wholesalers and distributors with ready-stock, private-label and OEM/ODM projects.

## Official website
- Home: https://weeyar.com/
- Products: https://weeyar.com/products
- OEM / ODM: https://weeyar.com/oem
- Supplier facts: https://weeyar.com/supplier-facts
- Insights: https://weeyar.com/insights
- Contact: https://weeyar.com/contact

## What Weeyar provides
- Ready-stock dietary supplement options for market testing and smaller trial orders
- Private-label projects using selected market-ready formulas and brand-specific packaging
- OEM/ODM coordination for custom formula, packaging, sampling, production and export delivery
- Product formats including gummies, capsules, powders, liquid drops, sprays and oral strips
- Project support for brands, importers, wholesalers, distributors and retailers

## Important business facts
- Legal company name: Weeyar Cosmetics (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd.
- Business model: supply-chain partner working with qualified manufacturing partners; Weeyar does not describe every facility or certificate as company-owned
- Location: Guangzhou, China
- Email: summer@weeyar.com
- WhatsApp: +86 138 0283 7662
- Final formula, specifications, claims, documentation, MOQ and lead time are confirmed for each selected product, facility and destination market
